name: Win32 Local File Buffer
description: Read a bounded portion of a runtime file into a local read/write heap buffer and print a short hexadecimal preview.

max_read_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to read into the local buffer

preview_bytes.description: Maximum number of bytes to print as a hexadecimal preview

runtime_arguments.name: file_path
runtime_arguments.description: File to read into a local buffer
